_comment: Canonical runtime configuration for the historical UK housing research prototype.

freshness.disclosure_text: This dashboard is a historical research prototype. It does not provide current real-time UK housing advice because the harmonized house-price panel ends before the current date.

sigma_cap_overrides._note: Per-region sigma cap overrides for _calibrate_sigma_by_region. Format: region_name -> annual_cap. Northern Ireland tested 2026-03-22 at cap=0.150 and cap=0.135 — median unchanged (42.38pp vs 42.30pp) confirming median is gamma/kappa-driven, not sigma-driven. No active overrides: the mechanism is available for future use. See R026.

fair_value._fair_value_weight_note: PTI/PTR blend weight. Set to data-driven estimate when available. Falls back to 0.60/0.40 expert prior if estimation fails or result is outside [0.30, 0.70].

_threshold_calibration_note.method: valuation_signal precision/recall/IR sweep, 36-month horizon, 2,220 region-month observations

supportive_threshold_evidence.rationale: Best balance of IR and recall among thresholds with meaningful sample size. Threshold 60 had higher precision (0.728) but recall collapsed to 0.169 (n=287).

cautious_threshold_evidence.rationale: Strongest well-populated cautious signal. Threshold 40 had perfect precision but only n=119. Threshold 50 diluted precision to 0.602.

excluded_thresholds.threshold_30: Degenerate: n_cautious=14, recall_cautious=0.014. Excluded from consideration despite best raw IR (-1.124).
excluded_thresholds.threshold_35: n_cautious=49. Too small for reliable inference.

app_consumer_weights._note: Expert-prior. Adjusted 2026-03-31: C2 (downside_probability) retired — column absent from panel, backtest returned NaN accuracy. Weight zeroed (0.10→0.0), redistributed to base_model (0.60→0.70). C3 accuracy=45.03% (<50%, -0.10 on affordability), redistributed to base_model in prior round. Last reviewed 2026-03-31.

app_reit_weights._note: Adjusted 2026-03-31: C2 (downside_probability) retired — column absent from panel, backtest returned NaN accuracy. Weight zeroed (0.25→0.0), redistributed to base_model (0.55→0.80). C4 (yield) accuracy=44.17% (<50%, -0.10 on yield_signal 0.30→0.20, redistributed to base_model in prior round). C5 (cycle) accuracy=63.05% (>=55%, weight unchanged). Last reviewed 2026-03-31.

scoring.c2_retirement_note: C2 (downside_probability) retired 2026-03-31. Column absent from canonical panel — backtest returned NaN accuracy. Signal retained in engine.py as optional parameter but zeroed from composite weights. Reactivate if downside_probability is computed in a future panel rebuild.

scenario_consumer_weights._note: Scenario probability priors for consumer weighted-return. Downside-skewed: adverse scenarios (Rate_Shock + Stagflation) weighted 0.45 combined. Expert-prior; not calibrated to historical frequencies. Last reviewed 2026-03.

scenario_reit_weights._note: Scenario probability priors for REIT weighted-return. Equal weight (1/N = 0.20) across 5 scenarios. Previously computed dynamically at runtime — now explicit. Last reviewed 2026-03.

Baseline.name: Baseline
Baseline.note: Historical baseline aligned to the canonical structural fair-value and baseline simulation assumptions.

Soft_Landing.name: Soft_Landing
Soft_Landing.note: Rates ease and financial stress normalises faster than in the baseline.

Rate_Shock.name: Rate_Shock
Rate_Shock.note: Mortgage repricing and tighter financial conditions push the path below the historical baseline.

Stagflation.name: Stagflation
Stagflation.note: Sticky inflation keeps real income weak and financial conditions tight.

Recovery_Boom.name: Recovery_Boom
Recovery_Boom.note: Lower rates, stronger income, and firmer demand support a better-than-baseline path.

ui_reference_values._note: Cross-regional averages from model backtests. For UI context only.

scenario_descriptions.Baseline: Gradual rate normalisation with steady real income growth; broadly consistent with OBR central forecasts.
scenario_descriptions.Rate_Shock: Bank Rate rises sharply to 6%+ and stays elevated; affordability severely compressed for 18–24 months.
scenario_descriptions.Stagflation: Persistent inflation with stagnant real incomes; real house prices erode even if nominal prices hold.
scenario_descriptions.Soft_Landing: Rates fall smoothly to 3.5%; affordability recovers without triggering a supply response.
scenario_descriptions.Recovery_Boom: Rapid rate cuts combined with strong wage growth; demand surge outpaces supply in constrained markets.

_fair_value_weight_note: Estimated 2026-04-02 via grid-search SSE on pooled panel. Clips to [0.25, 0.75].

sigma_floor_overrides._note: Raised from 0.030 to 0.045 on 2026-04-02. South West historical IQR ratio was 0.267 with standard prior. Floor ensures ratio >= 0.30. Governance: same mechanism as Wales (R020) and Yorkshire (R021) resolutions.
